original_plan.expected_observation: One admitted complete NMPC execution for candidate ab14d206 within the 3600 s cap, producing an evaluated trajectory whose inclusive 0.30-0.35 s holding max tip speed is <=0.02 m/s and holding max position error <=0.01 m (terminal position error <=0.01 m), or a sealed complete/failed/timeout receipt.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen task 2b26edb492214c426263441b6adb52d7aafe41a828436d6b48a1171374a1026c (target [0.29,0.035,0.19] m; tolerance 0.01 m; inclusive holding steps 30-35; holding speed limit 0.02 m/s; duration 0.35 s; control 0.01 s; MuJoCo timestep 0.0005 s; seed 17; zero initialization); frozen candidate ab14d2064efd7cf1ac2466120c20542b669a9cc0e849d7beff2a8fa51d46aad9 with d=-0.2394244339763736; frozen controller recipe controller.gvs_nmpc (holding_speed_cost_mode=time_integral_v1, holding_speed_cost_window_s=0.05, holding_tip_speed_weight=0.1, horizon 10, max_cpu_s 30); one deterministic nominal execution; no robustness claim; thresholds and discretization unchanged.
original_plan.hypothesis: A closed-loop model-based execution of the frozen gvs_nmpc recipe on frozen joint candidate ab14d206 (d=-0.2394244339763736) can satisfy the inclusive 0.30-0.35 s holding-window tip-speed limit (<=0.02 m/s) on frozen task 2b26edb4, because that recipe explicitly minimizes holding tip speed via a time-integral cost over the last 0.05 s window (holding_speed_cost_mode=time_integral_v1, holding_tip_speed_weight=0.1), which is exactly the metric both residual RL checkpoints violated (step-00199936-60ba20db policy_690637f6 -> 0.059066 m/s, evidence 1056fad5c7a463b9ebbbd7062ed582dc4fe822c66cefc543c33fe757bbfc1913; step-00599808-fef573bd policy_51bca330 -> 0.050042 m/s, evidence 3218d2977f61045cbe1da9275a3e04c9e2c672169fba8ab55eb59afaaa042ee5) and that the fixed reference trajectory reaches only marginally in the reduced model (0.018626 m/s, evidence 93eb8edcdfbe245d2e8b3d32e011b3f9a6cfa652dcc3c878858a639a71b18a96). A direct RL route is not the lever (evidence 034b4c1943763ddd3bec1d9d09af18db2172b1eecd0291d7b64dadd9aa3c50a7 failed holding position at 0.073686 m). Recorded holding samples (evidence b046dbef11ceed450f0ff342bfdeca947f65d56964efc377614558d3b7ad7289) show reference_tension/residual_correction as not recorded, so no decomposition is asserted.
original_plan.interpretation: A pass (holding speed <=0.02 m/s, position error <=0.01 m) supports freezing this exact NMPC result as selected_execution and proceeding to two fresh confirmations of the same selection. A measured failure would show that a model-based controller with an explicit holding-speed brake also misses the holding-window speed bar on this design, shifting weight toward a design/reference revision rather than further reward tuning. An unknown-termination timeout retains the reservation and is incomplete execution evidence with task performance unmeasured, never infeasibility. No superiority, robustness or causal claim is made either way.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop this NMPC arm once the single admitted execution returns a terminal status (complete evaluation, or a sealed known-termination failure/timeout receipt) under its 3600 s outer subprocess cap; no automatic replacement execution, and no new timing calibration is required for this first-use candidate.
original_plan.weakening_observation: Holding-window max tip speed >0.02 m/s, or holding/terminal position error >0.01 m, or an incomplete/timeout execution receipt (which is incomplete execution evidence with task performance unmeasured and is never design infeasibility).
